title: Listening to Instructions and Questions
introduction: Practise listening to instructions and questions with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Listen to short instructions and questions about familiar things.
rules: Ask a partner to read these classroom instructions aloud. Listen and act before reading the words.
Practise sequences of two or three instructions, such as 'Take your ruler. Draw a line. Put the ruler down.'
Request repetition politely: Please say it again.

vocabulary.description: Draw a line beneath a word.
Draw a round line around something.
Write the same letters or words.
Move to face another direction or move a page.

examples.question: A partner says: Circle the word frog. What should you do?
steps: Circle means draw around the word.

examples.question: A partner says: Underline your name. What should you do?
examples.answer: Draw a line below your name.

examples.question: A partner says: Pick up your book, then open it. What is first?
You did not hear the instruction. What can you say?
A partner says: Close the door, then sit down. What is last?

exercises.question: Complete: Draw a ___ under your name. (line or chair)
Which instruction means draw around a word: circle or underline?
Which instruction means write the same word: copy or erase?
Which instruction means stand in a line?
Which means select an answer: choose or close?
In 'Open your book, then read', what comes last?
In 'Pick up the pencil, then write', what comes first? (pick up or write)
Which means say something again: repeat or match?

summary: Listen to short instructions and questions about familiar things.
